title: Approval of Resolution Authorizing Travel of Commissioner
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Board of Water and Power Commissioners
  Approval of Resolution Authorizing Travel of Commissioner
  Rudy J. Ortega, Jr. to Sacramento, California from October 19, 2026 through
  October 22, 2026, representing the Department and Board of Water and
  Power Commissioners.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Authorize travel for Board Commissioner Rudy J. Ortega, Jr. to Sacramento from October 19-22, 2026 to represent the Department and Board of Water and Power Commissioners.
